newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Tae Sung, another default on debt.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Tae Sung, another default on debt.

text.p: South Korea's Tae Sung Machinery and Construction Co and Keum Kang Leather Co have defaulted on debt payments and their bank accounts would be frozen on Monday, statements from the two companies said on Sunday.
On Saturday, the Korea Stock Exchange already suspended trading in shares of Tae Sung, citing rumours.
A Tae Sung statement filed with the exchange said it had defaulted on promissory notes worth 1.03 billion won called in for payments by Saturday.
It said that the company was considering looking for a new owner or filing for court receivership and that a decision would be announced no later than the end of July.
Tae Sung, an iron and steel structure manufacturer, recorded a net loss of 3.13 billion won in calendar 1996 for the second consecutive year after reporting a 1.07 billion won loss in 1995.
